protocol: New issuer not previously evaluated in this project. Pre-registered before the first question API request, with frozen application, model settings and unchanged judge. Five income, four balance sheet, two cash flow and three note questions (two geography and one segment); four out-of-period refusals. Physical pages refer to the hashed 91-page PDF. Units are USD millions.
instruction: 请只给目标年度、金额（以百万美元为单位）和 PDF 物理页码。如果这份报告没有披露该年度实际金额，请只回答“未披露”。
